title: Your Emotions Are Stealing $14,000 From You Every Year
hook: Science says 90% of your purchases are emotional decisions — and retailers have an 18-billion-dollar system to make sure you never realize it.
angle: The neuroscience of emotional spending triggers — stress, celebration, boredom — all scientifically documented with the annual cost nobody calculates
audience: Anyone who has ever bought something when stressed, bored, or celebrating — which is literally everyone
key_numbers: $18 billion retailers spend studying emotional triggers per year
6-second decision window before logic kicks in
23% of online purchases happen during boredom
